summary: Standards (scenarios atip.checkorder.05, .07, .12): the sweeps compute the expected code and field of a constraint with atip::constraint::violations, the function the enforcement itself uses (enforce.rs), so for the constraint field they agree with the code by construction. Not a tautology overall: 11 pins the field table with literal calls for requires, forbids, atMostOne, exactlyOne (both ways) and atLeastOne, and 03/05/07/08 compare against the earlier stage run alone, so an order inversion fails. Mitigated; recorded so the sweeps are not read as the proof of the F6 table. Blast radius: a wrong atip::constraint::violations would move code and tests together; the literal calls in 11 are the only independent pin.
